chunks.sanskrit: apa̠ prāca̍ indra̠ viśvā̍gͫ a̠mitrā̍n apāpā̍co abhibhūte nudasva|
de̠vaṃ martā̍sa īḍate manye̎ tvā jā̠tave̍dasam|
pū̠ṣemā āśā̠ anu̍veda̠ sarvāḥ̎ so a̠smāgͫ abha̍yatamena neṣat|
agne̠ rakhṣā̍ṇo̠ agͫha̍saḥ prati̍ṣma deva̠ rīṣa̍taḥ|
dvāvi̠mau vātā̍ vātaḥ ā sindho̠rā pa̍rā̠vataḥ̍|
śa̠mbhūr ma̍yo̠ bhūrno̍ hṛ̠de praṇa̠ āyū̍gͫṣi tāriṣat||
sa̠mrāḍeko̠ virā̍jati sa i̠daṃ prati̍ paprathe|
upa̠praya̍nti̠ naro̍ a̠gnirū̍pāḥ ma̠nyurbhago̍ ma̠nyure̠vāsa̍ de̠vaḥ|
ya̠jñair ju̠hoti̠ yaju̍ṣā ha̠virbhiḥ̍ tan mṛ̠tyur nir·ṛ̍tyā savm̐vidā̠naḥ|
sva̠yaṃ kṛ̍ṇvā̠naḥ su̠gamapra̍yāvam ti̠gmaśṛ̍ṅgo vṛṣa̠bhaḥ śośu̍cānaḥ|
avā̍dha̠māni̍ jī̠vase̎ va̠yagͫ so̍ma vra̠te tava̍|
i̠ndrā̠ṇī de̠vī prā̠sahā̠ dadā̍nā sā no̍ de̠vī su̠havā̠ śarma̍ yacchatu||
i̠haivaidhi̠ mā vya̍thiṣṭhāḥ parva̍ta i̠vā vi̍cācaliḥ|
mā pa̍spharīḥ̠ paya̍sā̠ mā na̠ ā dha̍k|
ju̠ṣasva̍ naḥ sa̠khyā̍ ve̠śyā̍ ca mā tvatkhṣetrā̠ṇyara̍ṇāni ganma||
yo go̠jiddha̍na̠jida̍śva̠jidyaḥ i̠maṃ no̍ ya̠jñavm̐vi̍ha̠ve ju̍ṣasva|
dī̠khṣaye̠dagͫ ha̠virāga̍cchataṃ naḥ a̠gniśca̍ viṣṇo̠ tapa̍ utta̠maṃ ma̠haḥ|
viṣṇa̍va urugā̠yāya̠ dāśa̍t pra yaḥ sa̠trācā̠ mana̍sā̠ yajā̍ tai|
tve̠ṣagͫͫ hya̍sya̠ sthavi̍rasya̠ nāma̍ hotā̍raṃ ci̠trara̍thamaddhva̠rasya̍|
su̠ratnā̍so de̠vavī̍tiṃ gamema tvagͫ so̍ma̠ kratu̍bhiḥ su̠kratu̍rbhūḥ|
vibhū̍tadyumna eva̠yā u̍ sa̠prathāḥ̎ adhā̍ te viṣṇo vi̠duṣā̍ci̠dṛdhyaḥ̍|
bṛ̠hatte̍ viṣṇo suma̠tiṃ bha̍jāmahe i̠mā dhā̠nā ghṛ̍ta̠snuvaḥ̍|
śru̠to ga̠ṇa ā tvā̍ viśantu hari̍varpasaṃ̠ giraḥ̍||
hvayā̍masi̠ tvendra̍ yā̠hya̍rvāṅ araṃ̍ te̠ soma̍sta̠nuve̍ bhavāti|
gāvo̠ na va̍jrinth sva̠moko̠ accha̍ indrāga̍hi pratha̠mo yajñiyā̍nām||
yā te̍ kā̠kuth sukṛ̍tā̠ yā vari̍ṣṭhā|
ni vo̠ vanā̍ jihate̠ yāma̍no bhi̠yā|
vivi̍ñcanti̠ vana̠spatī̍n provā̍rata maruto du̠rmadā̍ iva|
savm̐vo̠ manā̍gͫsi jānatām de̠vā bhā̠gaym̐yathā̠ pūrve̎|
yathā̍ vaḥ̠ susa̠hā'sa̍ti sa̠jñāṃnaṃ̍ naḥ̠ svaiḥ|
aga̍nma̠ śarma̍ te va̠yam agne̠ hira̍ṇyasaṃdṛśaḥ||
śi̠śī̠hi rā̠ya ābha̍ra śipri̍n vājānāṃ pate|
bhū̠taṃ mā̠ tasmā̠dbhavyaṃ̍ ca dru̠pa̠dādi̍va muñcatu||
nya̍smindaddhra̠ ā manaḥ̍ tagͫ sa̠ddhrīcī̍rū̠tayo̠ vṛṣṇi̍yāni|
sūro̠ na mi̍trāvaruṇā̠ gavi̍ṣṭiṣu rajā̍gͫsi ci̠trā vi ca̍ranti ta̠nyavaḥ̍|
asū̍dayanta ta̠nuvaḥ̠ sujā̍tāḥ indra̍śca naḥ śunāsīrau|
tato̠ dharmā̍ṇi dhā̠raya̍nn tada̍sya pri̠yama̠bhi pātho̍ aśyām|
vī̠hi sū̍ra puro̠ḍāśa̎m upa̍ naḥ sū̠navo̠ giraḥ̍|
yathā̠ strī tṛpya̍ti pu̠g̠ͫsi pri̠ye pri̠yā|
e̠vaṃ bhaga̍sya tṛpyāṇi ya̠jñasya̠ kāmyaḥ̍ pri̠yaḥ||
na tā na̍śanti̠ na da̍bhāti̠ taska̍raḥ|
gāvo̠ martya̍sya̠ vica̍ranti̠ yajva̍naḥ rātrī̠ vya̍khyadāya̠tī|
u̠ruṃ no̍ lo̠kaṃ kṛ̍ṇuhi jīradāno prehya̠bhiprehi̠ prabha̍rā̠ saha̍sva|
yadīda̍gne̠ prati̠ tvaṃ de̍va̠ haryāḥ̎ suva̍rvatīra̠pa e̍nā jayema||
indro̍ jigāya̠ pṛta̍nāni̠ viśvā̎ indro̍ jā̠to vi puro̍ ruroja|
maddhvo̠ agraṃ̠ divi̍ṣṭiṣu āyā̍ hi̠ soma̍pītaye|
tato̍ na u̠gro vibha̍jā̠ vasū̍ni a̠sme dyā̍vāpṛthivī̠ bhūri̍ vā̠mam|
eka̍vṛṣā̠ indra̍sakhā jigī̠vān viśvā̠ āśāḥ̠ pṛta̍nāḥ sa̠jaṃya̠ñjaya̍nn|
viśa̍ścakre bali̠hṛtaḥ̠ saho̍bhiḥ pra sa̠dyo a̍gne̠ atya̎ṣya̠nyān|
brahma̍ṇā̠ svara̍vo mi̠tāḥ brahma̍ ya̠jñasya̠ tanta̍vaḥ|
ā su̍ma̠tivm̐vṛ̍ṇīmahe sa no̍ rāsva saha̠sriṇaḥ̍||
indrā̎gnī vṛtrahaṇā ju̠ṣethā̎m u̠bhā hi vā̍gͫ su̠havā̠ joha̍vīmi|
viśvā̎n de̠vāgͫͫ sta̍rpayata ha̠viṣo̠'sya nava̍sya naḥ|
pra̠jāṃ puṣṭi̍ma̠mṛtaṃ̠ nave̍na i̠me dhe̠nū a̠mṛta̠ym̐ye du̠hāte̎|
bhā̠ge de̍va̠ na mī̍yase sa e̍nā vi̠dvānya̍khṣyasi|
